video.title: AI欧腐《前夫同盟/The Ex-Husbands' Pact》
video.desc:
Leo endures a sexless sham marriage until exposing his wife's affair with Vesper, wife of tycoon Julian. Bound by betrayal, a dangerous, restrained tension draws their broken hearts closer. Forging a brilliant 'Ex-Husbands Pact,' they weaponize proof of infidelity and fraud to obliterate their foes, finding redemption in the ruins of revenge.
Leo 困在一段无性的假面婚姻里，直到他揭穿了妻子的婚外情——对方是 Vesper，大亨 Julian 的妻子。同为背叛所伤，两个男人之间生出一股危险而克制的张力，把两颗破碎的心越拉越近。
他们缔结了一份漂亮的"前夫协定"，把出轨与欺诈的证据化作武器，将仇敌彻底碾碎——并在复仇的废墟之上，找到了救赎。
